Traditional Speculaas Windmill Cookies

Served at: Sinterklaas Arrival (Intocht)

Makes about 3 dozen cookiesPrep 30 min (plus 4 hours chilling)Cook 10-12 min

Speculaas windmill cookies are a beloved Dutch treat, especially during the Sinterklaas season. Their distinctive spiced flavor and charming shapes make them a festive staple, often enjoyed as Sinterklaas and his helpers arrive in the Netherlands (Intocht) and throughout the holiday period. These crisp, aromatic cookies are perfect for sharing with family and friends as you celebrate the start of the Sinterklaas festivities.

Ingredients

  • 2 ½ cups (300 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 ½ tablespoons ground cinnamon
  • 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
  • 1 teaspoon ground cloves
  • ½ teaspoon ground ginger
  • ½ teaspoon ground cardamom
  • ¼ teaspoon white pepper (optional)
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • ½ teaspoon salt
  • 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1 cup (200 g) dark brown sugar, packed
  • 1-2 tablespoons milk or water (if needed)
  • ¼ cup (30 g) sliced almonds (optional, for decoration)

Method

  1. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, ginger, cardamom, white pepper (if using), baking soda, and salt.
  2. In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter and dark brown sugar with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
  3. Gradually add the dry ingredient mixture to the butter mixture, mixing on low speed until just combined. If the dough seems too dry, add milk or water one tablespoon at a time until it comes together.
  4. Divide the dough into two equal portions, flatten each into a disc, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight.
  5. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
  6. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one disc of chilled dough to about ¼ inch (6 mm) thickness.
  7. Use a windmill cookie cutter (or other festive shapes) to cut out cookies, re-rolling scraps as needed.
  8. Carefully transfer the cut-out cookies to the prepared baking sheets, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) between them.
  9. If desired, press a few sliced almonds onto the surface of each cookie for decoration.
  10. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the cookies are firm.
  11. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

Tips

  • For best flavor, prepare the dough a day ahead and let it chill overnight; this allows the spices to meld beautifully.
  • If you don't have a specific speculaas spice blend, the individual spices listed provide an authentic taste.
  • Store cooled cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to two weeks, or freeze for longer storage.
